name: Wraith
description: Moves through units and slips past blockers.

name: Bone Legion
description: A squad of 3 skeletons. Each rises once after falling.

name: Ghoul
description: A ravenous grave-dweller with heavy claws.

name: Necromancer
description: A frail summoner. Death bolts from range 2-3 cost 1 mana. Raise the Slain: enemy heroes it kills rise as Undead that fight for it for 3 turns.

name: Grave Knight
description: An armored dead champion that refuses to stay down.

name: Bone Rider
description: A skeleton on a skeletal steed. Rides down a target and rises once when it falls.

name: Lich King
description: Elite (5 slots). A crowned sorcerer of the grave. Soul Storm costs 2 mana, hits an area and stuns the target. Raise Dead: 2 mana summons a skeleton beside him.

name: Bone Colossus
description: Boss (5 slots). Ossuary: When it falls it breaks into 3 skeletons.

name: Death Knight
description: Boss (5 slots). Withering Strike: Its targets cannot be healed for 2 turns.

name: Banshee Queen
description: Boss (5 slots). Wail: Each attack also deals 1 damage to every other enemy next to her.

name: Plague Lord
description: Boss (5 slots). Plague Aura: Enemies that start their turn next to him take 2 damage.

name: Grave Wisp
description: Flying. Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.

name: Ossomancer
description: Detonates spent or summoned undead as a 4-damage burst of Bone Shrapnel (1 mana).

name: Bone Witch
description: Ossifies an enemy hero into a weak skeleton for a turn (3 mana).

name: Gravedigger
description: Digs Open Graves you can spawn next to, and earns gold from enemy deaths nearby (2 mana).
